## What the feasibility pass actually changed

Running your method properly killed two findings and promoted one.

**Died under testing:**
- **Skeleton wrapping `{afterContent}`** — structurally odd, but `info` is only `null` while loading, and at that point `hasOfferedColour` is false so `afterContent` is never passed. Not reachable. Demoted to one sentence.
- **`ProductDetailOptions` duplication** — I chased this because a pre-existing colour-swatch component would have made the whole PR redundant. It doesn't exist on any ref; the `overrideStyling.md` bullet claiming it "ships" is stale prose about an unmerged f2r prototype. Became a doc-fix note instead.

**Promoted to blocking** — and it's not the one CodeRabbit found:

CodeRabbit's Critical said the initial colour never reaches the URL. It missed `params.get(key) || variationValues?.[key]` (`use-variation-params.js:46`), which rescues variant products. But chasing that fallback surfaced the real defect: **a single-colour product loses its only colour control.** `hasOfferedColour` is true at one colour → suppresses the base SwatchGroup; `ColourSwatches` needs `length > 1` → renders nothing clickable. Reproduced:

```
firstOfferedColour !== undefined  => true   (suppressColourAttribute={true})
queryAllByRole('radio')           => 0
queryAllByRole('button')          => 0
queryAllByRole('link')            => 0
getByText('Bay Blue')             => present
```

`validateOrderability` then returns false on `variationAttributes.length > 0 && !variant`, so it's *"Please select all your options above"* with nothing on the page that can satisfy it. Ironically that's AC1's own scenario. Fix applied and verified: `tsc` clean, 407/407.

**One CodeRabbit finding I'm rejecting outright** — its minor asking to revert the `Quantity:` change. `develop` had the same message id with two conflicting `defaultMessage`s (`:761` `'Quantity'`, `:857` `'Quantity:'`), and no locale stored the colon. Reverting restores the conflict. I've written that up as pushback rather than passing it through.

**Two `audit-allow` comments were factually wrong**, both verified by applying the fix: `--zimm-icon-size-md` (16px) and `--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default` (2px) both exist and are named for exactly those uses. With both applied the component's acknowledged-exception list drops 10 → 5, and the 5 remaining are genuinely token-less.

## One thing I'd flag about my own evidence

I proved the single-colour chain in code and reproduced the missing-control half as a test, but I **did not drive a real master-product PDP in a browser** — the rendered outcome is inferred from the hook chain. I've said exactly that in the thread rather than overstating it. Worth one manual check before merge either way.

Also carried forward from #68: `qa.yml` still has only `e2e_homepage`, so `e2e_scope` resolves to `skip` again here. Second PR running — probably wants its own ticket, and it's a Tier 1 file so it shouldn't be folded into this one.

## First, a flag before the findings

The ticket's Design/Technical Notes point at a **different file** — `QQ427wHWEUjsjP7H8v48Rs` (`Zimmermann_Final-Approved-Designs`, node `3087-15747`). Everything below is measured against `Zimmermann_Design_System_2026`, which is what you gave me. Worth settling which is leading before anyone acts on the geometry items.

Also: **node `40003912:6219` returns "node ID was not found in the file."** Deleted, or the ID is off — nothing checked against it.

## What matches exactly — genuinely good

**Colours resolve to the same hex through the foundation files.** `alias/color/bg/surface/default` `#f6f4f1` → `--zimm-color-bg-02` → `ivory[200]` = `#f6f4f1`. `alias/color/field/border/focus` `#191919` → `--zimm-color-border-focus` → `grey[900]` = `#191919`.

**Typography is a four-way match.** Figma's `Default/Caption-strong` is 12px / 500 / 18px / letter-spacing 0; `textStyle: 'caption'` resolves to exactly that.

**The 44px / 28px spacing is Figma-derived and correct** — `40000307:13966` has `gap-[44px]`, `40000307:14062` has `gap-[28px]`. The chevrons are exact too (24px hit area, 16px icon), and the node reference in the code comment checks out. Both designer annotations are honoured — pagination >4, and truncation on a long name.

## Five real discrepancies

**1. Swatch is 48px wide in Figma, 47px in code.** All three Large/Rectangle states are `h-[72px] w-[48px]`. Height matches, width is 1px short — and it propagates into the `188px` container (4 × 47) where Figma's standalone frame is **192** (4 × 48).

**2. The container shouldn't have a fixed width at all.** In Figma the block is `w-full` — the instance measures **338 × 104 on mobile**, 218px-panel on desktop, with the 192px of swatches left-aligned inside. Pinning it to 188px truncates the colour name ~30px early on desktop and ~150px early on mobile, and pulls the chevrons that far off the right edge.

**3. Label row is 6px short whenever there are ≤4 colours** — the common case:

```
Figma            : 24 + 8 + 72 = 104   (instance height, desktop AND mobile)
code >4 colours  : 24 + 8 + 72 = 104   the 24px chevron sets the height
code ≤4 colours  : 18 + 8 + 72 =  98   caption line-height 18px, nothing else in the row
```

Figma's `labelContainer` is `h-[24px]` unconditionally.

**4. One gap where Figma has two.** Figma nests: 4px between "Colour:" and the name, 8px before the pagination. The recipe flattens all three into one 4px row.

**5. The image fills the box; in Figma it floats in the ivory field.** Most visible of the five:

```
Figma : w=48, h = 48 × 1.3   = 62.4  →  9.6px of #f6f4f1 showing
code  : w=47, h = 47 × 55/36 = 71.8  →  0.2px, effectively edge to edge
```

That `36 / 55` isn't a design value — it's what you get from dividing the already-1px-short 47 × 72 box. Figma's is 10:13, and there's a designer annotation on `40000307:13831` reading **"Image aspect ratio - 2:3"**, which 48:72 is exactly and 47:72 isn't. Same error carries into `SWATCH_IMAGE_HEIGHT = 147` — at the Figma ratio it's `96 × 1.3 = 125`.

One consequence worth calling out: the recipe's header comment says these dimensions were *"confirmed by designer."* On width, the file disagrees.

I just tried to close the biggest gap and **couldn't.** Here's the honest audit.

## Solid — I ran it and read the output

`tsc` exit 0 · `npm run test` 407/407 · mutation check (AC5 break → 3 failures) · `npm run lint` 30 vs develop's 19 with all 9 new ones git-blamed · `audit:tokens` failures byte-identical on develop and in files not in the PR · both token fixes applied → tsc clean, 407/407, audit list shrank 10→5 · the URL-sync fix applied → tsc clean, 409/409 · the single-colour repro test · duplicate message id at `:761`/`:857` · en-US British spellings and `en-US` being a live locale · 3-of-11 locale coverage · `filterImageGroups` exported at `product-utils.js:182` and imported from that same module at `:26` with no test · `qa.yml`'s `SCOPE="skip"` shell · all 11 specs `test.skip`.

Those I'd defend as-is.

## Not verified — and one of them is under the blocker

**1. That master products lack top-level `variationValues`.** This is the load-bearing link in the blocking finding. The mock I cited is a **variant** (`type: {variant: true}`). I just went looking for a master fixture to confirm the negative — the only candidates are nested inside product-set/bundle fixtures and the extraction was inconclusive. **So that step rests on SFCC API knowledge, not observation.** If masters *do* carry `variationValues`, the single-colour case still breaks (no control to click) but Add to Bag would work, which downgrades it from blocker to bug.

**2. I never rendered a real PDP.** The whole chain is code-traced. AGENTS.md forbids me starting the dev server.

**3. The Figma deltas are arithmetic, not measured.** On #68 you measured in headless Chromium and quoted real numbers. I computed `47 × 55/36 = 71.8` from the CSS. Deterministic, but not the same standard.

**4. "~30px / ~150px earlier truncation" is soft** — it assumes the real PDP column equals Figma's 218/338 frame widths. The app's column is whatever the grid gives. The *direction* is right; those numbers shouldn't be quoted.

**5. Label row = 18px** — inferred from caption line-height, not measured.

**6. "Five surfaces" for `variant="square"`** — I confirmed 2 unsuppressed `<ProductView>` renders and 3 base importers, but I did **not** verify the `ccExtensibility` resolver actually redirects those base files. A subagent asserted it.

**7. `ProductDetailOptions` doesn't exist** — a subagent searched all refs. I didn't personally re-run it.

**8. The CodeRabbit CLI output** — a subagent ran it. I independently verified the Critical and rejected the Quantity minor; the other four I'm relaying.

## What I'd do before posting

Three are cheap and I can do them now:

- **#3 and #5** — render the component in headless Chromium via Playwright and measure the actual box heights, matching your #68 standard
- **#6** — read the `ccExtensibility` config and confirm the redirect
- **#7** — re-run the ref search myself

**#1 and #2 need you** — either start the dev server so I can drive a real single-colour PDP, or confirm from BM whether a master response carries `variationValues`. Until then I'd soften Thread 1 from "Add to Bag is blocked" to "no colour control renders; orderability likely blocked on masters — needs one manual check," which is still request-changes but doesn't overclaim.
